name: Jupiter-Saturn:testing conviction
source:
The story follows an eccentric scientist (the protagonist) and his companion, who have been abducted by agents acting on behalf of the state and are being pressured to defect to the country that kidnapped them.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4782310/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
故事讲述了一位古怪的科学家（主角）和他的同伴被代表国家的特工绑架，并被迫叛逃到绑架他们的国家。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4782310/]Steam[/url]]
